generation.workflow: StyTrix reference-fidelity and single-variable process only; no paid StyTrix generation; one independent Image generation per concept
generation.renderRule: one left shoe, exterior side or three-quarter view, toe right, white/light-gray studio

hardConstraints: preserve each reference's category-level silhouette, visual, proportion, value structure and monochrome mood
remove all third-party names, letters, numbers, monograms and signature side marks
change exact panel maps and outsole tooling enough to remain an original MOVERNO proposal
useMOVERNO Motion Contour becomes panel, cage, support tape, reflective rail or shroud; never arbitrary decoration
image-model output is concept evidence, not a factory technical drawing
referenceDuplicate: References 07 and 11 are byte-identical. Both requested outputs were produced: 07 exposes a linear cage; 11 uses a semi-transparent removable shroud.

researchAnchors.title: Vogue Japan — 2026 spring/summer sneaker trend keywords
researchAnchors.use: Confirms a 2026 split between restrained classics and expressive/maximal sneakers; MOVERNO intentionally keeps the user's maximal runner language in a monochrome system.

researchAnchors.title: Vogue Japan — 2026-27 low-profile sneaker shift
researchAnchors.use: Used as a counter-signal: the chunky family must be a deliberate brand signature rather than a generic market default.

researchAnchors.title: TikTok Shop LIVE — sneakers and streetwear community commerce
researchAnchors.use: Supports later content that explains construction, materials and authenticity instead of showing only static glamour imagery.
